params.name: url
params.description: Fully URL-encoded target URL, including http:// or https://.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format - html (default), json, or md (Markdown).

params.name: country
params.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 country code to geolocate the request (for example US, DE, GB).

params.name: device
params.description: Device profile - desktop (default), tablet, or mobile.

params.name: user_agent
params.description: Override the User-Agent header sent to the target.

params.name: scraper
params.description: Name of a built-in extractor to apply to the crawled page (returns parsed JSON).

params.name: autoparse
params.description: Auto-detect the page type and return parsed JSON.

params.name: page_wait
params.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load before capture (JavaScript token only).

params.name: ajax_wait
params.description: Wait for AJAX / network idle before capture (JavaScript token only).

params.name: css_click_selector
params.description: CSS selector to click before capture (JavaScript token only).

params.name: scroll
params.description: Scroll toward the bottom of the page before capture (JavaScript token only).

params.name: scroll_interval
params.description: Maximum seconds to scroll (default 10, max 60).

params.name: screenshot
params.description: Capture a JPEG screenshot of the rendered page (JavaScript token only).

params.name: get_headers
params.description: Return the target's response headers alongside the body.

params.name: get_cookies
params.description: Return the target's Set-Cookie values.

params.name: cookies_session
params.description: Sticky session identifier to reuse cookies across requests.

params.name: store
params.description: Persist the response in Crawlbase Cloud Storage.

params.name: async
params.description: Queue the request and return immediately with a request id (rid).

params.name: callback
params.description: Webhook URL that Crawlbase posts async results to.

items.docs: Fetches the target `url` through Crawlbase's proxy network and returns the page. Use the Normal (TCP) token for static HTML/JSON, or the JavaScript token to render the page in headless Chrome before returning it. Crawlbase status is surfaced in the `pc_status` response header; requests that do not return `pc_status: 200` are not charged.
